set.title: Practice Test 1: ABC Company Full Cycle
set.description: Full accounting cycle based on the uploaded sample: opening SFP, journal entries and ending SFP.
set.caseHtml:
ABC Company has the following balances as of December 31, 2023:

  • Bank deposit: $220,000
  • Cash on hand: $35,000
  • Accounts receivable: $32,000
  • Merchandise inventory: $85,000
  • Finished goods: $110,000
  • Raw materials: $28,000
  • Tools and supplies: $6,000
  • Short-term investments: $25,000
  • Long-term prepaid expenses: $10,000
  • Machinery and equipment: $260,000
  • Buildings: $180,000
  • Accumulated depreciation: $55,000
  • Accounts payable: $62,000
  • Borrowing and finance lease liabilities: $120,000
  • Salaries payable: $14,000
  • Taxes and other payables: $16,000
  • Unearned revenue: $9,000
  • Bonus and welfare fund: $7,000
  • Owner’s contributed capital: $180,000
  • Retained earnings: X

During January 2024, the company completed 17 transactions: collection from customers, supplier payment, office equipment purchase, salary/tax payment, raw material purchase, sale of finished goods, sale of merchandise on credit, owner contribution, loan repayment, employee advance and settlement, advance from customer, service revenue, purchase of tools, depreciation, and advertising expense.
requirements: Calculate total assets as of December 31, 2023.
Calculate total liabilities as of December 31, 2023.
Calculate retained earnings as of December 31, 2023.
Prepare the Statement of Financial Position as of December 31, 2023.
Prepare the Statement of Financial Position after the January 2024 transactions.
set.solutionHtml:
A. Opening calculation

  • Total assets = $936,000.
  • Total liabilities = $228,000.
  • Total equity = $936,000 - $228,000 = $708,000.
  • Retained earnings = $708,000 - $180,000 = $528,000.

B. Key journal entries

No.DebitCredit
1Bank deposit 20,000Accounts receivable 20,000
2Accounts payable 25,000Bank deposit 25,000
3Office equipment 45,000Bank deposit 15,000; Accounts payable 30,000
6Raw materials 30,000Bank deposit 18,000; Accounts payable 12,000
7Cash 75,000; Cost of goods sold 42,000Sales revenue 75,000; Finished goods 42,000
8Accounts receivable 50,000; Cost of goods sold 28,000Sales revenue 50,000; Merchandise inventory 28,000
13Cash 12,000Unearned revenue 12,000
16Depreciation expense 6,000Accumulated depreciation 6,000

Note: the complete page keeps this as a compact answer key, not a full textbook solution, to keep the UI clean.

C. Ending Statement of Financial Position

  • Ending total assets = $1,022,000.
  • Ending total liabilities = $205,000.
  • Owner’s contributed capital = $240,000.
  • Ending retained earnings = $577,000.
  • Total liabilities and equity = $205,000 + $240,000 + $577,000 = $1,022,000.
